title: SkyrimNet Plugins Index
description:
Machine-generated aggregate of all plugin manifests. Regenerated by build-index.yml on every push to main. Never edited by humans — PRs that modify index.json are rejected by validate.mjs. Contains the fields the dashboard needs to render the browse page, filter and sort, plus the per-bundle version history the in-game installer resolves a version to a commit SHA with. Anything else (description, external_url, invocation block, full mod metadata) is fetched from the individual plugin's manifest.json on detail view.

Field formatting matches the (relaxed) manifest schema — index entries are permissive on string content because the dashboard is the canonical authoring source.

schema_version.description: Bump when the entry shape changes in a breaking way. Dashboard refuses unknown versions. v2 is the content-store format: adds plugin_id and history, renames skyrimnet_version to min_skyrimnet_version, and drops the knowledge content count (knowledge packs are not a v1 content type).

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last rebuild. Null before the first run.

id.description: Repo-path key for this entry: 'plugins/{author}/{slug}'. This is the key hidden.json and curated.json are written against, and the subtree the installer fetches. The author segment is the SaaS-assigned immutable username (uniqueness + immutability enforced at signup, so paths never collide and never break). Neither segment may contain a dot — the dot is the separator in plugin_id.

plugin_id.description: The plugin's canonical content-store id ('{author}.{slug}') copied from manifest.json. This is the identity the engine uses everywhere: store/ directory name, registry keys, duplicate-id resolution. Case-folded equal to the path in `id`; carried explicitly so consumers never have to parse one out of the other.

type.description: Copied from manifest.json. Controls dashboard card rendering (install button vs external-link button) and the 'installable only' filter in browse.

external_url.description: Required for listings, absent for bundles. Mirrored from manifest.external_url so the browse page can render an 'open external' link without fetching the full manifest.

title.description: Copied from manifest.json. Globally unique across the repo (case-insensitive).

tagline.description: Short one-liner shown on browse cards. Copied from manifest.json.

author.description: The author's SaaS-assigned immutable username. Copied from manifest.json. Also forms the author segment of the plugin path.

min_skyrimnet_version.description: Minimum SkyrimNet version this bundle needs (strict semver). Copied from manifest.json. Drives the dashboard's 'compatible with my install' filter and the installer's compatibility gate — plugins needing a newer SkyrimNet install disabled with an 'Enable anyway' button rather than being blocked.

history.description: Published version history for bundles, newest first, derived from git. Each entry pins a version to the newest commit at which the plugin carried that version, which is exactly what the installer needs: install/update takes history[0], rollback takes any earlier entry and re-runs the same code path against the older SHA. Capped — old versions beyond the cap are not offered for rollback. Absent for listings (nothing to install).

version.description: manifest.version as it stood at that commit (strict semver).

commit.description: Full commit SHA the installer fetches the plugin subtree at. Commit-pinned raw URLs are immutable, so this is also the cache key.

nsfw.description: Copied from manifest.json. Controls whether this plugin is visible in the default (NSFW-off) browse view.

icon.description: Copied from manifest.json. Key into the dashboard's Lucide icon registry; rendered as the browse-card thumbnail.

contents.description: Required for bundle plugins. Absent for listing plugins (they have no content files in the repo). File counts derived by walking the plugin directory. `bios` counts character bios (files under prompts/characters/); they are their own category and are excluded from the `prompts` count. Knowledge packs are punted and are not accepted by the validator.

mods.description: Always present (empty array when the plugin has no mod integrations). Includes 'name' for display, 'file' (lowercased) for compatibility matching, and 'required' flag.

name.description: Human-readable mod name for display in browse listings.

file.description: Lowercased plugin or DLL filename. Matched case-insensitively against the user's installed plugin list by the dashboard.

hidden.description: Present only when the plugin is hidden. Copied from hidden.json so the dashboard can filter the browse view and still show the reason on the author's own profile page. Absent (not null) for visible plugins.

curated.description: Present and true only for curated plugins (from curated.json). Absent otherwise.

first_published.description: Derived from: git log --reverse --format=%aI -- plugins/{author}/{slug}/ | head -1
